expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: The authorization request is invalid or too old. Go back to the app you were connecting and start again.

unknownClient.title: Unknown app
unknownClient.body: The app asking for access is not registered with Leafdesk or has been disabled. Go back and try connecting again.

heading: {client} wants to access your Leafdesk account
unverified: This app registered itself automatically and has not been reviewed by Leafdesk. Only continue if you started this connection.
readOnlyHint: Uncheck to give read-only access. Every edit is saved to page history first, so you can undo it.

access.all: Access covers every workspace you belong to. You can disconnect the app at any time in Settings.
access.listed: Access covers every workspace you belong to: {workspaces}. You can disconnect the app at any time in Settings.
access.awaitingApproval: {count, plural, one {{workspaces} lets in only the apps its owners approved: this app won't reach it until one of them approves it.} other {{workspaces} let in only the apps their owners approved: this app won't reach them until an owner approves it.}}

redirectNotice: You will be sent back to {host}.
error: Could not complete the request. Go back to the app and try again.

scopes.offlineAccess: Stay connected without asking you to sign in again
scopes.pagesRead: Read pages and databases in your workspaces
scopes.pagesWrite: Create and edit pages and database rows, and move pages to the trash
